companyName: Surrey Pretrial Services Centre Expansion Project

result.rationale: The Surrey concession remains one active ProjectCo, but its current Equitix/Jura attribution is false. Executed documents identify Brookfield and Forum at the 2011 close; Forum acquired Brookfield's interests in 2015; and Fiera acquired 100% on April 19, 2016 and still lists Surrey as an unrealized EagleCrest/Woodford investment. JLIF's complete 2017 portfolio omitted Surrey, so the 2018 Jura transaction did not convey it.

evidence.purpose: Direct Fiera evidence for the 100% acquisition and April 19, 2016 closing.
Current Fiera portfolio evidence for EagleCrest/Woodford attribution and unrealized status.
Executed ProjectCo ownership schedule identifying the original Brookfield and Forum parties.
Complete pre-takeover JLIF portfolio showing that Surrey Pretrial was not a JLIF asset.
